d: Three months after two Election Commissioners raised objections to a controversial work allocation order, the Election Commission of India has issued a fresh order restoring oversight of its IT and ICT divisions. The July 28 order had placed the IT division, headed by Director General Seema Khanna, directly under the Commission, bypassing the Deputy Election Commissioner-level reporting structure.
